Both touch basal-ganglia/control-learning machinery, but P11 centers PBWM gating demand/diffusion and CTL-02 centers TAN modulation of OpAL uncertainty/flexibility.

P17 is a behavioral evidence-accumulation model; CTL-03 is a neural effective-connectivity model under perturbation.
